title: catalog.tour v1.1 (CIS → AA-Booking, TripPlanner)
description: One live AA tour as the CIS catalog read model exposes it (ADR 0001 decision 1, AA-679). Assembled from the views of schema `catalog` (CIS migration 225): the tour fields are one row of catalog.v_tour, `days` are its catalog.v_tour_day rows, `places` its catalog.v_tour_place rows, `photos` its catalog.v_tour_photo rows. Only tours whose Master Content is active and whose source is the active version appear; a tour that leaves the catalog (inactive, trashed, superseded) is simply absent. Key = (source_system, source_id), stable across re-uploads; tour_id is the current CIS version and changes on re-upload. A consumer re-syncs a tour when content_hash changes. No prices: prices are AA-Booking's (ADR 0005). Events catalog.tour.published / updated / trashed (outbox) come in a later additive version; until then consumers poll catalog.v_tour. v1.1 (S237, CIS migration 228, AA-712): additive over v1 — places[] gain located_by and precision; places[].destination_id now comes from the CIS place pipeline's link first (then the place card, then the v1 exact name + country match), and a suspect or duplicate destination is never returned (destination_id, destination_name, lat, lng null). catalog.v_destination gains geo_status, located_by, precision (rows of catalog.graph.v1 point at it). Consumers must accept version 1 and 1.1.

source_id.description: Stable CIS id of the tour: silver_aa_internal.raw_tours.source_group_id (a uuid string). The sync key together with source_system (contracts README rule 3; 'external_ref' in older docs).

tour_id.description: Current CIS version of the tour (raw_tours.tour_id). Changes on re-upload; never use it as the key.

source_version.description: raw_tours.source_version — increments on each re-upload of the same source_id

slug.description: URL hint: '<title>-<country>' lowercased, non [a-z0-9] runs replaced by '-', max 80 chars, then '-' + first 8 hex of source_id. Unique; changes when the title changes. Not an identity.

highlights.description: AA master highlights (published_tours.aa_highlights, JSON as authored — usually an array of strings)

country.description: Country name as CIS normalises it (raw_tours.country, e.g. 'Vietnam', 'Sri Lanka'). ISO codes are not part of v1 (open decision, AA-679).

duration_days.description: First 'N day(s)' in duration_raw, else the highest day number of the canonical itinerary; null when neither exists

lifecycle_stage.description: Sales lifecycle of the source: active | phasing_out | retired (catalog does not filter on it)

itinerary_text.description: Whole AA master itinerary. Canonical form 'Day N — Title\nBody' blocks; a non-canonical (legacy) text yields no `days`.

cover_photo_path.description: Path relative to the CIS public API base: GET {base}{path}?size=large|small returns the image (Dev base https://api-cis.lumiguides.it.com)

updated_at.description: Latest of published_at and the tour's photo updates. Informative only, NOT a change cursor: published_tours has no updated_at, so an in-place Master Content edit changes content_hash without moving updated_at. Detect changes by diffing content_hash.

content_hash.description: md5 over every content field above (incl. cover photo path). Changes iff the content a consumer copies changes.

places.description: place_name of this day's `places`, in position order (see places[].position)

day_number.description: null = mentioned by the tour without a day

position.description: 1-based order within the day: order of first mention (case-insensitive) in the day's title + body, i.e. itinerary order. Places the day text does not name come after, in a stable order that carries no itinerary meaning.

place_name.description: Place as the tour's content names it: the spelling written in the day text, else the most frequent spelling among the tour's atoms (deterministic).

destination_id.description: shared.destinations id (catalog.v_destination): the CIS place pipeline's link for this tour, day and place, else the place card's destination, else an exact name + country match; null = not located yet, or only a suspect / duplicate destination matched

lat.description: Point of the destination. Draw it as located_by / precision say, with the Geoapify + OpenStreetMap attribution when located_by = geoapify

lng.description: Point of the destination. Draw it as located_by / precision say, with the Geoapify + OpenStreetMap attribution when located_by = geoapify

located_by.description: Who placed the point. geoapify = confirmed by the geocoder: wherever it is shown, show "Powered by Geoapify" (https://www.geoapify.com/) and "© OpenStreetMap contributors" (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). llm = the model's point (usually precision area). manual = admin fix. mapbox = legacy TripPlanner row not yet re-confirmed. null = never located.

precision.description: point = draw a pin; area = draw an area, not a pin (unconfirmed point); null = legacy row the CIS place pipeline has not processed yet.

examples.title: Hanoi and Ha Long
examples.itinerary_text:
Day 1 — Arrive in Hanoi
Welcome dinner.

Day 2 — Ha Long Bay
Cruise.
